source.title: Belfast Telegraph, 2 June 1967, p. 8 ("Sion tops the poll: rural elections with 96 pc"); Belfast News-Letter, 2 June 1967, p. 2 ("Poll surprises in many areas"); Larne Times, 8 June 1967, p. 9 ("Rural District of Larne: Notice of Result of Elections, 1967")
source.publisher: Belfast Telegraph (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: Votes read from the Belfast Telegraph, 2 June 1967, p. 8, and the Larne report of the same date.

note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors, polled Thursday 1 June 1967 in Carrickfergus Rural and Glynn. All 16 divisions are taken from the returning officer's notice of result (R. Beck, returning officer; Larne Times, 8 June 1967, p. 9): two polls, twelve sole candidates declared elected, and in Ballycorr and Middle Division the retired members were deemed re-elected. No party labels are printed; places of residence are not reproduced. Rea defeated the sitting member Blair by 33 votes; 82 pc poll.
